newSection: Verify new section Global KxI Manager will be added into the existing KxI Engine on Add/Edit Role Permission screen.
oldSection: Verify KXI Definition Management section for KXI Engine Roles Permission will be removed.
readPermission: Verify if Global KxI Manager has read permission then it will be only allowed to view tasks, KxI Definitions & Data instead of the owner.
weightNotChanged: Verify if Global KxI Manager has read permission then it won't be allowed to update weight on linked KXI definitions on risk insight screen.
createPermission: Verify if Create rights are assigned to Global KxI Manager then by default read+create+updated permissions should be selected in add/edit role permisson screen.
unselectReadPermission: Verify if user selects create then read+create+update will be select and if user unselects read option then create & update should also get unselect automatically on add/edit role screen.
userBeAbletoCreate: Verify user will be able to create KxI Definitions , KxI Data, Tasks instead who the owner or assignee is if create permissions are assigned to Global KxI Manager.
deletePermission: Verify if user selects Delete  option on Global KxI Manager role permission section then read+create+update+delete should be selected by default in KxI Engine on add/edit role screen.
uncheckDelete: Verify if user unselect create/update then delete option should automatically unselect on add/edit role screen in KxI Engine.
disableUpdate: Verify if user selects create then update will be selected automatically and it will be read only so that user can't edit update selection.
uncheckUpdate: Verify if user unselects create then update should also unselect automatically.
userBeAbletoDelete: Verify if Delete is permission is given to Global KxI Manager then user will be able to delete task, KxI Definition & Data
